newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLO curve to flatten, spread to edge out.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLO curve to flatten, spread to edge out.

text.p: The Belgian linear bond (OLO) market wound down a shortened session on Tuesday in quiet but firm dealings in what many dealers said was the calm before the storm.

They predicted once end-investors returned on Thursday after the New Year's Day break the market was in for a swift bout of profit-taking, that would push the spread over Bunds wider and flatten the overall shape of the yield curve.
"I think it's clear that on the first day prices will be marked down," one trader said. He believed the fair value of benchmark 10-year OLOs was 20 basis points over Bunds.
